Work / Break Timer

A simple repeating work/break timer (like 90/20 ultradian rhythm): set work and break lengths and it cycles automatically with a chime.

Ready
90:00
Completed cycles: 0

Cycles Work → Break automatically with a chime on every switch.

📖 How to use

  1. Set your work minutes and break minutes (defaults 90 / 20).
  2. Press Start — the timer alternates Work → Break → Work automatically.
  3. A chime sounds on every switch; the cycle counter tracks completed rounds.
  4. Pause any time, or Reset to start fresh.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is this different from a Pomodoro timer?

It is simpler: one work length and one break length repeating forever, with no long-break cycle. Ideal for ultradian rhythms like 90 minutes on / 20 off.

What is the ultradian rhythm?

Research suggests the brain works well in ~90-minute focus cycles followed by ~20-minute breaks. The defaults reflect that pattern.

Does it stay accurate in a background tab?

Yes — timing is driven by wall-clock timestamps, not tick counting.
